dynamicInputs.label: Supabase URL
dynamicInputs.description: Project URL. Example: https://abcdefghijklmno12345.supabase.co. You may also paste just the project ref.

dynamicInputs.label: Database Connection String
dynamicInputs.description: Postgres connection string from Project Settings → Database. You can also set this in Parameters as Database URL.

dynamicInputs.label: Service Role Key
dynamicInputs.description: Optional Service Role key from Project Settings → API (enables API checks).

dynamicInputs.label: Project Reference
dynamicInputs.description: Optional explicit project ref. Inferred from URL when omitted.

dynamicOutputs.label: Project Ref
dynamicOutputs.description: Supabase project reference for the scan.

dynamicOutputs.label: Summary
dynamicOutputs.description: Summary metadata from the scanner output.

dynamicOutputs.label: Issues
dynamicOutputs.description: Array of issues flagged by the scanner.

dynamicOutputs.label: Results
dynamicOutputs.description: Analytics-ready findings with scanner, finding_hash, and severity. Connect to Analytics Sink.

dynamicOutputs.label: Scanner Report
dynamicOutputs.description: Full JSON report produced by the scanner.

dynamicInputs.label: Data
dynamicInputs.description: Any data to log (objects will be JSON stringified).

dynamicInputs.label: Label
dynamicInputs.description: Optional label to identify this log entry.

dynamicOutputs.label: Logged
dynamicOutputs.description: Indicates whether the log entry was emitted.

dynamicOutputs.label: Preview
dynamicOutputs.description: Short preview of the logged content.
